allocation.en: The committee reviewed the allocation of funds for student activities.
allocation.zh: 委員會檢視學生活動經費的分配。

allot.en: Teachers allot extra time for students who need clarification.
allot.zh: 老師會分配額外時間給需要說明的學生。

alteration.en: One small alteration made the poster easier to read.
alteration.zh: 一個小修改讓海報更容易閱讀。

alternatively.en: Alternatively, you can submit the assignment through the school website.
alternatively.zh: 或者，你可以透過學校網站繳交作業。

amnesty.en: The history lesson explained why the government announced an amnesty.
amnesty.zh: 歷史課說明政府為何宣布特赦。

analects.en: The class read selections from the analects during the philosophy unit.
analects.zh: 哲學單元中，班上閱讀《論語》的選文。

ancestral.en: The museum preserves records connected to the community's ancestral traditions.
ancestral.zh: 博物館保存與社區祖先傳統有關的紀錄。

anecdote.en: The speaker opened the lecture with a short personal anecdote.
anecdote.zh: 講者以一則簡短的個人軼事開場。

angler.en: An angler waited quietly beside the lake at sunrise.
angler.zh: 日出時，一名釣客安靜地在湖邊等待。

angular.en: The architect used an angular design for the modern building.
angular.zh: 建築師為現代建築採用了有稜角的設計。

antibody.en: The biology lesson explained how an antibody recognizes a specific target.
antibody.zh: 生物課說明抗體如何辨識特定目標。

appal.en: Reports of unfair treatment can appal people who value justice.
appal.zh: 不公平待遇的報導可能讓重視正義的人震驚。

appalling.en: The documentary described appalling living conditions from a historical period.
appalling.zh: 紀錄片描述某段歷史時期令人震驚的生活環境。

appetizer.en: The restaurant served a small appetizer before the main course.
appetizer.zh: 餐廳在主餐前端上一份小開胃菜。

apprehension.en: She felt some apprehension before speaking to the large audience.
apprehension.zh: 在大批觀眾前演講前，她感到有些不安。

april.en: The school festival is usually held in april each year.
april.zh: 學校園遊會通常每年四月舉行。

aptitude.en: The activity helped students discover an aptitude for design.
aptitude.zh: 這項活動幫助學生發現自己在設計方面的才能。

armchair.en: An old armchair stood beside the bookshelf in the reading room.
armchair.zh: 閱覽室書架旁放著一張舊扶手椅。

ascertain.en: Researchers gathered more data to ascertain the cause of the change.
ascertain.zh: 研究人員蒐集更多資料以確定變化原因。

ascribe.en: Scientists should not ascribe a result to one cause too quickly.
ascribe.zh: 科學家不應太快把結果歸因於單一原因。

aspiration.en: Her aspiration is to study environmental science at university.
aspiration.zh: 她的志向是在大學研讀環境科學。

aspiring.en: The workshop gives aspiring writers a place to share ideas.
aspiring.zh: 這個工作坊讓有志成為作家的學生交流想法。

assertion.en: Every assertion in the report should be supported by evidence.
assertion.zh: 報告中的每項主張都應有證據支持。

assertive.en: She was assertive without being disrespectful during the debate.
assertive.zh: 辯論時她表達堅定，但沒有不尊重他人。

assertively.en: He spoke assertively while explaining the group's final decision.
assertively.zh: 他堅定地說明小組的最後決定。

asylum.en: The article explains the legal meaning of asylum in international affairs.
asylum.zh: 文章說明庇護在國際事務中的法律意義。

australia.en: Our geography project compares rainfall patterns in australia and Asia.
australia.zh: 我們的地理專題比較澳洲與亞洲的降雨型態。

availability.en: The website shows the availability of seats for each workshop.
availability.zh: 網站顯示每場工作坊的座位供應情況。

avenge.en: The novel questions whether people should avenge past wrongs.
avenge.zh: 這本小說探討人們是否應報復過去的不公。

awaking.en: The poem describes the quiet feeling of awaking before sunrise.
awaking.zh: 這首詩描述日出前醒來的寧靜感受。

awkwardly.en: He smiled awkwardly after realizing he had entered the wrong room.
awkwardly.zh: 發現走錯房間後，他尷尬地笑了笑。

baby-sitter.en: The family hired a baby-sitter for the evening event.
baby-sitter.zh: 那個家庭為晚間活動請了一位保母。

bail.en: The civics textbook explains how bail works in a legal system.
bail.zh: 公民課本說明保釋制度如何運作。

ballad.en: The music class listened to a traditional ballad from the region.
ballad.zh: 音樂課聆聽了一首來自該地區的傳統民謠。

ballroom.en: The old hotel converted its ballroom into an exhibition hall.
ballroom.zh: 老飯店把舞廳改成展覽廳。

baptism.en: The history course discusses baptism as part of religious tradition.
baptism.zh: 歷史課把洗禮作為宗教傳統的一部分來介紹。

bargaining.en: The lesson examines bargaining as a method of reaching agreement.
bargaining.zh: 課堂探討協商作為達成協議的方法。

based.en: The conclusion is based on evidence collected during the experiment.
based.zh: 這項結論是根據實驗期間蒐集的證據。

bathtub.en: The old house still has a large bathtub upstairs.
bathtub.zh: 那棟老房子的樓上仍有一個大浴缸。

faraway.en: The story takes place in a faraway village near the mountains.
faraway.zh: 故事發生在山區附近一個遙遠村莊。

february.en: The school calendar lists the winter break dates in february.
february.zh: 學校行事曆列出二月的寒假日期。

fifteen.en: Fifteen students joined the reading club after school.
fifteen.zh: 有十五名學生加入放學後的閱讀社。

fifth.en: Our classroom is on the fifth floor of the building.
fifth.zh: 我們的教室在大樓五樓。

fifty.en: The library ordered fifty new books for the language section.
fifty.zh: 圖書館為語言區訂購了五十本新書。

five.en: Five teams presented their projects during the morning session.
five.zh: 上午場共有五組發表專題。

forehead.en: A few drops of rain landed on his forehead.
forehead.zh: 幾滴雨落在他的額頭上。

forgetful.en: He became forgetful when trying to manage too many tasks.
forgetful.zh: 同時處理太多事情時，他變得容易忘東忘西。

forty.en: The lecture lasted forty minutes before the discussion began.
forty.zh: 講座持續四十分鐘後才開始討論。

four.en: Four students volunteered to organize the science display.
four.zh: 有四名學生自願協助整理科學展覽。

fourteen.en: Fourteen pages of notes were reduced to a short summary.
fourteen.zh: 十四頁筆記被濃縮成一份簡短摘要。
